text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right before the finish line,
it felt like I was freed from everything...
Like I was at the peak of absolute freedom!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well? Looking at me, did you end up
feeling that way too, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Next time, let's run even more "freely"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Is that so, is that so~!
Aren't you glad, Palmer-san~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah. But running all-out without a single worry in the world is probably thanks to having such a great Trainer by my side.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Looking forward to working with you from now on... and all that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Riding this high, why don't we
go hang out somewhere right now?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, even more than that?! Seriously~?!
Talk about super high standards.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Still, you know, I kinda feel like I can really pull it off.
Next time... and the time after that, a totally free running style
that makes my past runs look puny by comparison!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aaalright! I'm getting more and more hyped!
Keep this max-hype energy going, alrighty!
